title: Add data validation on DataFrame append
summary: Implement data validation for the Collection.append() method to ensure schema compatibility between existing and appended data. This includes validation of column names, data types, and index types with configurable strictness levels.

approach.description: Add optional schema validation to the append method that checks column compatibility, dtype matching, and index type validation before allowing data to be appended. Validation will be configurable via new parameters allowing users to choose between strict (fail on mismatch), warn (log warning but continue), or disabled modes.

validation_types.description: Verify that appended data has all columns present in existing data
validation_types.behavior: strict: raises ValueError, warn: logs warning, disabled: no check

validation_types.description: Verify that matching columns have compatible dtypes
validation_types.behavior: strict: raises ValueError, warn: logs warning, disabled: no check

validation_types.description: Verify that index types are compatible
validation_types.behavior: strict: raises ValueError, warn: logs warning, disabled: no check

validation_types.description: Check for columns in new data that don't exist in existing data
validation_types.behavior: strict: raises ValueError, warn: logs warning, disabled: allows extra columns

implementation_steps.description: Add validation parameters to append method signature

changes.change: Add new parameters: validate_schema (bool, default=False), schema_strictness (str: 'strict'|'warn'|'disabled'), and track_validation_errors (bool)

implementation_steps.description: Create helper method to extract schema from existing item

changes.change: Add private method _get_item_schema(item) that returns column names, dtypes, and index type of existing data
Add private method _validate_data_compatibility(new_data, existing_schema, strictness) that returns validation result with detailed error messages

changes.location: append method, after data copy and before index filtering (line ~203)
changes.change: Call validation method if validate_schema=True and handle result based on strictness setting

implementation_steps.description: Add error messages and warnings for validation failures

changes.change: Implement detailed error messages showing which columns/types mismatch

new_parameters.name: validate_schema
new_parameters.description: When True, validates schema compatibility before appending data

new_parameters.name: schema_strictness
new_parameters.description: Controls behavior on validation failure: 'strict' (raises exception), 'warn' (logs warning and proceeds), 'disabled' (no validation)

new_parameters.name: allow_extra_columns
new_parameters.description: When True, allows appended data to have columns not present in existing data

test_strategy.description: Add unit tests for validation functionality in tests/test_validation.py

test_cases.description: Test that append raises error when columns don't match and strictness='strict'
Test that append logs warning when columns don't match and strictness='warn'
Test dtype validation between existing and new data
Test that extra columns are allowed when allow_extra_columns=True
Test that extra columns are rejected in strict mode
Test that validation can be disabled entirely
Test that error messages are clear and informative

risk_1.mitigation: Schema extraction is lazy - only metadata is read, not full data. Validation adds minimal overhead compared to actual append operation.

risk_2.mitigation: Validation is opt-in by default (validate_schema=False). Existing behavior is preserved.

risk_3.description: Handling nullable dtypes and type coercion
risk_3.mitigation: Use pandas.api.types.is_dtype_equal for strict comparison, allow compatible type coercion in warn mode.

risk_4.mitigation: Add special handling for different index types with appropriate validation logic.

estimated_files_to_change.changes: Add ~80-100 lines for validation logic (parameters, helper methods, integration)
New file with ~100-150 lines for validation tests

backward_compatibility: Full backward compatibility - validation disabled by default
